about_the_game:
holoVillage: Our Cozy Days is a game where you can enjoy a slow and carefree rural life together with your favorite VTuber.

Join the cute chibi versions of VTuber talents from hololive Production as you develop your village, explore dungeons, build houses, and enjoy a relaxing slow life together.

Relaxing slow life with farming, mining, and fishing

In the village, you can till the fields, go fishing, craft items with collected materials, open a shop and do business... Enjoy your time freely and leisurely with hololive members in your own way.

Exciting dungeon exploration

Outside the village, enemies appear and powerful bosses await in dungeons, providing thrilling adventures for those who seek more action. Gather equipment and aim for even greater heights!

Rich housing features

Decorate your home or shop with furniture and items inspired by hololive talents to create your own unique interior or fan room. You can also upload your room to the server for others to see or visit your friends’ rooms!

hololive talents visiting the village

Familiar hololive talents appear as villagers and help you in your daily life and adventures. Rooms you create can be made public for other players to visit — and maybe even your oshi might drop by!

A wide variety of costumes

You can freely dress up your favorite hololive talents in various outfits. From casual clothes to school uniforms, even swapping outfits between talents is possible. Dress up your oshi in the outfit you love!

Multiplayer elements

A multiplayer mode where multiple players can play together is also planned. With both cooperative and mischievous play options, the way you enjoy the game expands even further!

Until release, be sure to add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned!
